sql: WITH remuneracao_2025 AS (SELECT CAST(SUBSTR(CAST(seq_dat_pagamento AS VARCHAR), 5, 2) AS INTEGER) AS mes, MAX(CAST(vlr_rmn_liquida AS DECIMAL)) AS maior_remuneracao FROM remuneracao_municipio r JOIN pessoa_municipio p ON r.seq_dim_pessoa = p.seq_dim_pessoa WHERE r.ano_referencia = 2025 AND r.dsc_sit_serv_pens ILIKE '%Ativo%' AND COALESCE(p.nom_pessoa, '') NOT ILIKE '%NAO INFORMADO%' GROUP BY r.seq_dim_pessoa, mes) SELECT mes, SUM(maior_remuneracao) AS total_remuneracao FROM remuneracao_2025 GROUP BY mes ORDER BY mes;
